'Ojisan wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki.' Announces Additional Cast
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tsutomu's Ojisan wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki. (Middle-Aged Man Loves Cute Things) manga revealed an additional cast and a key visual (pictured) on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 4 at 10.00 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS Asahi and Yomiuri TV on October 5.
